item.title: When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts
item.description: A modern storefront can look healthy while malicious JavaScript quietly siphons revenue, hijacks clicks, or rewrites analytics. See how Cloudflare's machine learning models surface evasive client-side attacks for analyst investigation. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot
item.description: A rewrite this size wasn't affordable before agents. Here's what porting the Copilot agent runtime to 800,000 lines of production Rust actually took. (1 source: githubblog)
